newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Petrochemical to issue 1.34 bln yuan bonds.
newsitem.headline: China Petrochemical to issue 1.34 bln yuan bonds.

text.p: China National Petrochemical Corp plans to issue 1.34 billion yuan in three-year corporate bonds to the public in December, a company official said on Wednesday.
The official told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter that the bonds would be issued at par of 1,000 yuan per unit and carry annual interest of 10.5 percent.
China Southern Securities and Shanghai Guotai Securities will be the main underwriters for the issue, he said.
China Petrochemical is awaiting approval from the State Planning Commission and central bank, he said.

The firm plans to use the money raised from the issue in seven major petrochemical projects, including one in Maoming city in Guangdong province and one in Xinjiang in the northwest, he said. He did not provide further details.
